reviews.text: I use their services to install a Murphy bed. I had no instructions. They took the time to look it up and find out how to hang it properly. I paid the price they quoted. They were very easy to communicate with. They were very punctual. Very nice.
reviews.author: Joy Hocking

reviews.text: I had an urgent toilet issue that needed taken care of. I called a couple other companies and received no-callback. I called Calvin’s 24 hour handyman service. Calvin got back to me right away and was able to come out that same night. Calvin was awesome and professional and fix the issue that I couldn’t fix. I would highly recommend Calvin’s handyman service!!!
reviews.author: Carisa

reviews.text: We hired Calvin to do some general maintenance and they have gave me an estimate lower than anybody else in the area and even noticed some other problems with the house that could cost more in the future fixing it for a very good price.
reviews.author: Cole Patrick

reviews.text: Calvin is great to work with. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tyler Ashworth

reviews.text: I hired Calvin to fix some plumbing in my new home. He did a terrible job isolating the problem, diverted to something else (which come to find out he made way worse), and didnt even address the problem we called him out for. He is the type of handyman that comes to collect his service fee and do as little work as possible. I would never recommend his services.
reviews.author: Miranda Starr
